title: Integrated Engineering of T4 gp32 Achieves Synergistic Improvements in Thermostability, DNA Binding, and Diagnostic Robustness for Enhanced Nucleic Acid Amplification.
authors: Zhang, Lin; Zhang, Jiaxing; Wu, Lvping; You, Shengping; Su, Rongxin; Qi, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟和理性设计工程化改造单链DNA结合蛋白gp32，提升其热稳定性和DNA结合能力，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但属于蛋白质-DNA互作且方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Single-stranded DNA-binding protein gp32 is essential for DNA replication and widely used in isothermal amplification techniques such as recombinase polymerase amplification (RPA). However, its inherent thermal instability and reaction condition sensitivity restrict its broader applications. Here we develop the Fermentation Integrated Rational Engineering (FIRE-3S) strategy to enhance the functional properties of gp32 through molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, structure-guided fermentation tuning and stability-focused rational design. Starting from a disulfide-bonded mutant (V62C/T80C) that showed enhanced RPA performance but reduced thermostability, MD simulations revealed local structural disruption near the Zn(2+)-binding motif. Then, structure-guided fermentation tuning was applied, which restored structural integrity and enhanced DNA-binding affinity. Building on 2S-step, a computationally guided clique-based design pipeline rapidly identified a multisite mutant, gp32-M1, with elevated thermostability (DeltaT(m) = +6.03  degrees C), robust ssDNA-binding, and strong inhibitor tolerance horizontal line maintaining >65% activity under 4% isopropanol or ethanol. This work establishes a systematic framework for engineering ssDNA-binding proteins with enhanced biostability and environmental resilience for molecular diagnostics.
abstract_zh: 单链DNA结合蛋白gp32对DNA复制至关重要，并广泛用于重组酶聚合酶扩增（RPA）等等温扩增技术中。然而，其固有的热不稳定性和反应条件敏感性限制了其更广泛的应用。在此，我们开发了发酵集成理性工程（FIRE-3S）策略，通过分子动力学（MD）模拟、结构引导的发酵调控和以稳定性为重点的理性设计来增强gp32的功能特性。从一株表现出增强RPA性能但热稳定性降低的二硫键突变体（V62C/T80C）出发，MD模拟揭示了Zn(2+)结合基序附近的局部结构破坏。随后，应用结构引导的发酵调控，恢复了结构完整性并增强了DNA结合亲和力。在2S步骤的基础上，一个计算引导的团簇设计流程快速识别出多位点突变体gp32-M1，其热稳定性提高（ΔT(m) = +6.03 摄氏度），具有稳健的ssDNA结合能力和强抑制剂耐受性——在4%异丙醇或乙醇条件下保持>65%活性。这项工作为工程化具有增强生物稳定性和环境适应性的ssDNA结合蛋白建立了一个系统框架，适用于分子诊断。
